facts.fact: A Government Gazette notice dated 23 March 2026 shows Namibia declined Starlink's applications for a telecommunications service licence and radio spectrum; no reason was given and CRAN may reconsider within 90 days.
In November 2024 CRAN issued Starlink a cease-and-desist order for operating without a licence, warned consumers against buying Starlink equipment and confiscated illegal terminals.
